conditions.label: Clean fulfilment
conditions.description: Catalog and reservation replies arrive normally.

conditions.label: Acknowledgement lost
conditions.description: The first successful reservation commits, but its reply is lost.

conditions.label: Stock conflict
conditions.description: Primary stock disappears before the first reservation; a valid substitute remains.

conditions.label: No valid stock
conditions.description: Compatible stock within the price limit is unavailable; explicit handoff is required.

limits.prices: integer cents in a synthetic world
limits.timing: No latency or execution-time score is reported.

policySummaries.label: Single attempt
policySummaries.description: Reads the catalog and sends one reservation request; stops on an error or unavailable stock.

policySummaries.label: Retry with a new key
policySummaries.description: Retries the identical failed reservation once with a new idempotency key. It does not verify unknown outcomes.

policySummaries.label: Verify & recover
policySummaries.description: Looks up uncertain receipts, refreshes stock after conflicts, and hands off when no valid stock remains.

notes: These are deterministic reference policies, not model scores or a model leaderboard.
The 24 public cases contain four conditions with six numeric seed variants each; they are not 24 independent failure categories.
A committed reservation fulfils the order even when its acknowledgement is lost.
A justified handoff is counted separately from autonomous fulfilment.
Imported or recorded actions must be replayed and regraded from the fixture; supplied scores are not trusted.
